title: Evaluation of Lung Cancer CT Screening Performance Among Former and Current Smokers
official: Evaluation of Lung Cancer CT Screening Performance Among Former and Current Smokers: a "Real Life" Study
summary: Diagnostic performance of low-dose chest CT scan combined with lung-RADS classification (version 1.1) for lung cancer screening among former and current smokers.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female 50-80 years old
* Active smoker (≥ 15 PA) or former smoker (≥ 15 PA)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Recent history of chest CT scan (within 12 months)
* Person unable to climb 2 floors
* Weight \> 140kg
* Personal history of cancer \< 5 years (currently being monitored by thoracic imaging)
